payload.title: dispatchers keep a second unknown-verb refusal
payload.body: With capability-commands at d969e08a, runCli refuses an unknown verb itself, saying what to do (the verbs and cratylus <capability> --help). The dispatchers keep their own older refusal, worded without a way forward: packages/runtime/src/capabilities/event-tap/dispatch.ts:190 and packages/runtime/src/capabilities/plan/argv.ts:77 ('<cap>: unknown verb ... (expected a|b|c)'). It cannot be reached from the command line any more, only by calling dispatch* directly as a library, so the command line still has one refusal. Open question for the design holder: should the library guard go, or say the same thing as the command line.
